name: Moria
overview: Moria Casán celebrates her 80th birthday and opens the doors to a fictionalized version of herself as the puppeteer of her own story. Three great actresses — Sofía Gala Castiglione, Griselda Siciliani, and Cecilia Roth — portray her at different stages of her life. The series is not just the portrait of a star who spans film, theater, and television; it is the story of a woman who turned transgression into a way of survival and a tribute to Argentine popular culture.
